article.title: Kansai: ねん explicativo
article.part: Variación social y regional — 社会変異・地域変異
article.chapter: Dialectos y variación regional — 方言・地域変異

claims.summary: The claim that 〜ねん in Kansai dialect is frequently used at the end of sentences with an explanatory or emphatic value, similar to 〜んだ/〜のだ in standard Japanese.

The explanation that 〜ねん does not have a single translatable meaning and its function depends on the construction and intonation, being used to introduce explanations, justify statements, reinforce assertions, or present relevant information.
The examples provided (そうやねん、明日は休みやねん、今、ちょっと忙しいねん) illustrate the use of 〜ねん to express explanations or confirmations.
